title: Cube Poop Karne Wala Anokha Jaanwar! 🐻 #shorts
idea: Explaining how wombats naturally produce cube-shaped poop and other incredible biological facts about them in Hinglish.

lines.text: Dunya mein ek aisa jaanwar hai jo chaukona yani cube shape poop karta hai!
Ye hai Australia ka Wombat, jo har ek raat 80 se 100 cubes banata hai!
Inka khana hazam hone mein poore 8 se 14 din lagte hain!
Puraane zamaane ke Wombat 360 kg tak bhaari hote the!
Aur toh aur, UV light mein ye jaanwar neon tarah chamakta hai!
Kya aapne pehle kabhi cube poop karne wale jaanwar ke baare mein suna tha?
